$comment: #59 — link-checker ignore list. A HOST listed here still gets checked
(its result is printed) but a 4xx/5xx or network failure against it is
logged as a WARNING instead of failing the job — reserved for hosts
that are independently known to rate-limit or intermittently block
automated checkers, not a place to silence a link that is actually
broken. Every entry must be reviewed in the PR that adds it and carry
a `reason` explaining the observed flakiness (host, date, symptom).
As of #59 landing, no entry was needed — every external link this repo
documents returned 200 to a browser-like User-Agent when this ignore
list was authored. Add entries here, with review, if that changes.
